name: 67637 · Ellis, KS
findings: ZIP 67637 (Ellis) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67637 (Ellis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67637 (Ellis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
